test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Dead Sea, a highly saline water body is located in which of the following continents?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asia.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dead Sea**

 
 
• A** salt lake bordered by Jordan to the east and Israel and the West Bank to the west.**
 
• **Length: 50km**
 
• **One of the saltiest bodies of water on Earth, with almost 10 times more salt than ordinary seawater.**
 
• **And this is **because** the water flows into the Dead Sea from one main tributary, the River Jordan. It **then has **no way to get out of the lake and so is forced to evaporate.**
 
• **The human body can't sink in it due to the salinity which makes it heavier and denser than freshwater.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a7c9ca52b561e312bab5289b6960ff3f30a7fd4638866af28c14f00224741cc.png] ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Continents and Oceans**

 
 
• A** continent is any of several large landmasses.**
 
• Ordered from** largest in the area to smallest,** **seven continents** are** Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia.**
 
• **Oceanic islands are frequently grouped with a nearby continent to divide all the world's land into geographical regions.**
 
• **Oceans are Pacific (the largest), Atlantic, Indian, Southern (Antarctic), and Arctic (the smallest).**
